items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I give Homer Eugene my job.

ctx.x: to the tuxedo dance hall, you know? You went to the tuxedo dance hall too? What's that? Did you play tuxedo dance hall? Well you're at the tuxedo dance hall. You're supposed to

have been playing every Octave CrossFit. Oh yeah, tuxedo, yeah, after I left the entertainers we went down there. Tuxedo. Well Eddie Grouchel owned that in the doghouse too, you understand this? Oh I see. Yeah, he owned two clubs. But after that pulled up out there, they started tearing down, you know that's part of the old district. They started to move out there and I went by the, then I left there. I give Homer Eugene my job. You understand playing? Homer Eugene Wendell's brother, I give him my job playing…

And also Henry Rust, we talked to Henry Rust a couple of weeks ago and he talked about when you played with him in Chinatown. Yeah, yeah, he too. Yeah, yeah. So who was in that band? It was just a four piece player?
